title: October CincyRb - Jim Weirich on Decoupling from Rails
summary: A Cincinnati Ruby meetup talk by Jim Weirich on decoupling application logic from Rails. He argues for separating business logic from framework and database models.
why: Cited in HN debates on testing and clean architecture as a concrete example of keeping domain code separate from Rails so tests run fast.

quote.text: was quite interesting, and argued a complete separation of business logic from the model code
